This [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] was drawing to an end and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issuing [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], he was inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] library when he [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|witnessed]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] enter with two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. He watched in horror when Skywalker, now [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, executed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]]. Along with other Jedi in the room, he tried to avenge Nu's death, but was slain by Vader which led to the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].
